title: Reddit Upgrades AI Moderation Tools and Community Management System to Lower Karma Threshold and Enhance User Engagement Experience

content_html:
Reddit announced upgrades to its platform infrastructure and community management tools, introducing more advanced AI-driven moderation capabilities. It plans to reduce reliance on traditional mechanisms such as account age and Karma values through an automated abuse prevention system, making it easier for new users to participate in communities.

For a long time, Reddit has used the digital reputation system called Karma to assess the quality of user contributions. Users can gain upvotes and increase their Karma value by posting and commenting with valuable content. This mechanism was initially designed to reduce spam, bot accounts, and malicious activities. However, as more communities began using Karma values and account age as posting requirements, it became increasingly difficult for new users to engage in discussions. Reddit stated that it hopes to rely more on its improved built-in abuse prevention system for moderation, allowing communities to be more open to real users. Although the company has not explicitly mentioned abolishing the Karma system, its importance is expected to gradually decrease.

Meanwhile, Reddit is expanding the testing scope of its AI moderation tool "Rules Hub." This tool uses large language models (LLMs) to understand the intent behind community rules, helping moderators determine whether posts or comments comply with regulations and supporting automatic rule enforcement. The Rules Hub is currently being used in over 700 communities and is expected to be available to all communities later this year.

In addition to AI moderation, Reddit has upgraded several community tools, including a feature that provides users with hints about community rules when they post or comment, as well as a personalized tag function that allows users to set tags visible only in specific communities. Additionally, the company plans to migrate the old desktop site Old Reddit to a new technical architecture, transferring moderator management processes and updating related robot systems.

content_html_zh:
Reddit 宣布升级其平台基础设施和社区管理工具，引入更先进的人工智能驱动的审核功能。 它计划通过自动滥用预防系统减少对帐户年龄和业力值等传统机制的依赖，使新用户更容易参与社区。

长期以来，Reddit 一直使用名为 Karma 的数字声誉系统来评估用户贡献的质量。 用户可以通过发布和评论有价值的内容来获得点赞并增加他们的Karma值。 该机制最初旨在减少垃圾邮件、机器人帐户和恶意活动。 然而，随着越来越多的社区开始使用 Karma 值和帐户年龄作为发帖要求，新用户参与讨论变得越来越困难。 Reddit 表示，希望更多地依靠其改进的内置滥用预防系统进行审核，让社区对真实用户更加开放。 尽管该公司尚未明确提及废除Karma系统，但其重要性预计将逐渐下降。

与此同时，Reddit 正在扩大其人工智能审核工具“Rules Hub”的测试范围。 该工具使用大型语言模型 (LLM) 来了解社区规则背后的意图，帮助版主确定帖子或评论是否符合法规并支持自动规则执行。 目前，规则中心已在 700 多个社区使用，预计今年晚些时候将向所有社区开放。

除了AI审核之外，Reddit还升级了多个社区工具，包括在用户发帖或评论时为用户提供社区规则提示的功能，以及允许用户设置仅在特定社区可见的标签的个性化标签功能。 此外，该公司还计划将旧的桌面网站Old Reddit迁移到新的技术架构，转移版主管理流程并更新相关机器人系统。
